Her element — francium: the last element ever discovered in nature, found in 1939 in Paris by a former laboratory assistant who traced a rare branch in the decay of actinium, and named for France; the youngest of the alkali metals after caesium and rubidium, so restless that its longest-lived form lasts only twenty-two minutes and only a few dozen grams exist in the whole Earth at any moment, so no one has ever seen a piece of it; it has shown itself only as a tiny glowing cloud of atoms caught where laser beams cross, and like its sisters it would flare and boil in water if it ever stayed long enough — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.
